notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.5.1
notes.content:
-Fixed the aim offset bug for police (occurring when kneeling or looking upwards).

-Added aim offset functionality for the monster.

-End game screens renewed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.4
notes.content:
-Fixed issue where the "Options" menu would not open in the lobby.

-Players now have access to all characters in every mode.

-Reduced post-processing film grain and slope effects.

-Fixed door glitches.

-The whispering sound now stops if you stay away from the Monster for five seconds.

-Reduced whispering sound volume by 50%.

-Reduced the vignette effect area.

-Keys now glow three times brighter, making them easier to spot.

-Added a new "Important Mechanics" section to the "How to Play" menu.

-Fixed in-game cursor bug in the "Options" menu.

-Added a new "Brightness" option in "Graphic Settings," allowing brightness adjustments.

-Increased the AI Monster's random roaming and fast chasing range to double for better game balance.

-NPC Zombies now wait one second before charging at players.

-A new mechanic has been added to the AI Monster: she becomes deaf when the fire alarm is activated and doesn't respond to sound events while the alarm is ringing.

-Fixed an issue where clients were not spawning in multiplayer modes.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.3
notes.content: A few bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.4.2
notes.content:
A new sound effect has been added when the player gets close to a monster.
A new key glow effect has been added.
NPC zombies have been fixed in PvE modes.

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.content: Input key indicators have been added to the skill images, and an interaction widget has been implemented that appears when you are within range of an interactable object.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 Singleplayer & 2-4 Player Support
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the game now supports single-player mode and multiple player counts.
